context.content: I’m 27, and over the past 2 years I’ve discovered I’m actually gay. This wouldn’t be an issue if: I didn’t have a 3 year old daughter, and if I wasn’t in a 6 year relationship with a woman that recently ended. Needless to say, she’s hurt. I’m the bad guy. And I’ve become a social pariah. My ex wants sole custody, and I feel that I cannot win this. I feel like the biggest scumbag but also free at the same time. But I also feel strange. I’m in my late 20’s and I’m figuring out dating and my sexuality again. For so long I *knew* I was gay but kept it hidden. When I turned 25, I had a drunken sexual encounter with one of my former friend’s friend at a bachelor party. Spent the night in his hotel. I’m not proud of it. I did not tell my ex this, but I’m sure she suspects about me cheating (I hate to admit it, but I have). I came out to her and told her I’m gay and my life fell apart. Currently living in a small apartment, and I’ve made a throwaway account I think I might make my own... Bros, whats been your experience with this? And advice? DMs welcome. This is a hugely difficult time in my life. Please understand that. **Edit:** I just want to say thanks so much. The amount of support and tips and advice has been great.
